whoItsFor: Developers and technical users who want a self-hosted, customizable personal AI agent they can run in a browser, terminal, or chat app. They need their own model provider account or a local model server.
useCases: Summarize or work with local PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Chat with the agent through Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat, or Email
Run scheduled automations and long-horizon tasks with saved memory

requirements.os: macOS 13+, glibc 2.17+ Linux, or Windows x64 (for bundled-TUI platform wheels)
requirements.runtime: Python ≥ 3.11 (Git and Bun for source installs)
